meta.name: github-actions-templates
meta.description: Create production-ready GitHub Actions workflows for automated testing, building, and deploying applications. Use when setting up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, automating development workflows, or creating reusable workflow templates.

copy.tagline: 搭好自动化测试构建部署流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想用GitHub Actions把测试部署流程模板化
copy.tagline_en: Set up automated test, build, and deploy pipelines with GitHub Actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to templatize your testing and deployment workflows on GitHub Actions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按你的要求生成 GitHub Actions 的工作流配置文件（YAML 格式）。这些模板覆盖自动测试、构建 Docker 镜像、部署到 Kubernetes、矩阵构建等场景，并会遵循固定版本、缓存依赖、使用密钥等建议写法。
howto.when: 当你要用 GitHub Actions 搭建持续集成/持续部署（CI/CD）、实现自动化开发流程（如自动测试、构建、部署），或创建可复用的工作流模板时，Claude 会采用此技能。

say.text: 帮我生成一个 Node.js 的 GitHub Actions 测试工作流。
say.note: Claude 会给出测试工作流的 YAML 配置。

say.text: 写一个构建 Docker 镜像并推送到 ghcr.io 的配置。
我要一个部署到 Kubernetes 并且带安全扫描的流程。
say.note: Claude 会给出含扫描与部署步骤的模板。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude writes GitHub Actions YAML workflows: test, Docker build, Kubernetes deploy, matrix builds, etc., and follows best practices like pinning versions, caching, secrets.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use GitHub Actions for CI/CD setup, automating development workflows (e.g., testing, building, deploying), or creating reusable workflow templates.

say_en.text: Generate a GitHub Actions test workflow for Node.js.
say_en.note: Claude will output the YAML config for the test workflow.

say_en.text: Write a config to build a Docker image and push it to ghcr.io.
say_en.note: Claude produces a workflow with login, build, and push.

say_en.text: I need a Kubernetes deployment pipeline with security scanning.
say_en.note: Claude provides a template with scan and deploy steps.
